video_title: Lenovo paid YouTube creator partnership tracked for peachietech
evidence: CollabFeed's public Lenovo partnership feed records peachietech in a paid YouTube Lenovo gaming-laptop partnership posted August 12, 2026, with about 1.3K tracked views and 84 likes when indexed. The same feed records a separate Lenovo YouTube partnership with The Tech Chap on August 8, 2026, confirming active August creator spend rather than a one-off historical integration. Lenovo sells tangible laptops, PCs, tablets and gaming hardware. Lenovo's official Affiliate Program publishes NA_affiliate@lenovo.com specifically for the North America Affiliate Team, satisfying the qualified outreach-contact requirement. Lenovo/lenovo.com were checked against the permanent sent/block ledger and repository immediately before staging and no matching key was found.
